# 1535. Find the Winner of an Array Game

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def getWinner(self, arr, k):
        """
        :type arr: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        max_arr = max(arr)
        cur_round = 0
        p = 1
        while True:
            if arr[0] == max_arr or cur_round == k:
                break
            if arr[0] > arr[p]:
                cur_round += 1
            else:
                cur_round = 1
                arr[0] = arr[p]
            p += 1
        return arr[0]
```
